steps.text: An aftershock! Willow Pond is glowing, like the portal does. Go and look.
Someone climbed out of Willow Pond. Say hello.
Things keep going wrong round town. Put them right.
checklist: Swap the mud pies at the bakery for real ones

steps.text: Tell the real Nina about the girl from the pond.
Find the other Nina at Willow Pond.

reward.message: The other Nina has gone back through the pond. For now. +15 sparkles.
